title: Local rehearsal design
decision: The rehearsal for S1.5 uses PostgreSQL 16 containers with pgBackRest, an archive timeout of 60 seconds, a scripted failover that fences the old primary before promotion, and an S3-compatible file store; it is a rehearsal of the procedure only and does not stand in for launch criteria 8 and 12
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 13
rationale: It lets the failover and restore procedure be exercised and timed before servers exist, so that the first real rehearsal starts from a working script
